Sonic modulus test on SS soil at relative density o.84; apparatus: shock tube using compressed air; piezoelectric stress gages at each end of a triaxial specimen; oscilloscope arrival times; loading: stress wave from the shock tube driver pressurized to the same pressure each time (peak stress somewhat less than 2 psi); confining pressure by partial vacuum inside a rubber diaphragm. Recorded: modulus vs confining pressure. One of 2 tests drawn from the same figures.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The numbers below were digitized from the published figure by two readings made separately; they agree within the stated reading bounds at 17 of the 21 points, and 2 are still under review. Student reviewers have looked at 8 of the 21 points on the scan; none has yet been confirmed by two reviewers (see the provenance page). The test setup is incomplete: unit weight, tool, bin or mold, fill depth, rate are not reported.
:::

## Data

![modulus E = ρc² (wave velocity) against confining pressure, SI units, this test in red and the other tests printed in Fig. B-5 in gray. Error bars are reading bounds (half-widths from the digitization), not standard deviations. Filled markers were agreed by both readings, hollow ones were not.](../img/plots/b68-sonic-fb-5-dr84.png){.lightbox}

Peak modulus E = ρc² (wave velocity) 256.34 MPa at 67.3 kPa confining pressure; 256.96 MPa at 67.5 kPa, the end of the record.

Download: [observations.csv](../files/data/experiments/b68-sonic-fb-5-dr84/observations.csv) (21 points: 7 plotted symbols, 11 samples of the drawn curve; columns `x_si`, `y_si` with bounds `x_bound_si`, `y_bound_si`; panel 1: modulus E = ρc² (wave velocity) in Pa against confining pressure in Pa; the printed-unit values, the pixel position on the scan and the review status of each point are kept in further columns) and [series.json](../files/data/experiments/b68-sonic-fb-5-dr84/series.json) (units, conversion factors, how the points were read).

Reading bounds on this figure (how far our reading of the printed figure may be off, not the uncertainty of the test): typical bound 188 Pa in confining pressure, 373.4 kPa in modulus E = ρc² (0.1 percent of the peak). Both independent readings agree within these bounds at 17 of the 21 points; 2 are still under review (hollow in the plot) and 2 were settled against the scan. [Check the digitized points against the scan](../figures/index.qmd#check-fb-5).
